formal_feedback_disqualifiers.reason: Formal feedback must add causal value beyond exact fallback.

formal_feedback_disqualifiers.condition: feedback lacks failing constraint IDs, MCS rows, or counterexample fields
formal_feedback_disqualifiers.reason: Binary pass/fail feedback is not localized repair evidence.

formal_feedback_disqualifiers.condition: formal specification can pass while functional behavior is wrong
formal_feedback_disqualifiers.reason: Formal feedback needs a functional or semantic vacuity guard.

formal_feedback_disqualifiers.condition: feedback exposes the exact label or final answer before candidate generation
formal_feedback_disqualifiers.reason: Feedback is not evidence if it reveals the answer.

global_disqualifiers.condition: exact labels, answers, expected fixes, or split identity appear in prompts or candidate IDs
guided or verifier-selected success equals solver-only fallback with no positive delta
repair copies fixture answer, exact solver assignment, or metric definition
parse/schema/format passes but semantic tests or exact validators are absent or fail

global_disqualifiers.blocks: headline verifier, abstention, and repair claims
global_disqualifiers.condition: headline model identity is replaced by a smaller or different model without explicit boundary

perturbation_categories.non_vacuous_gate: exact label unchanged and solver-only baseline reported

perturbation_categories.name: candidate_label_flip_verification_variants
perturbation_categories.non_vacuous_gate: correct and incorrect candidates share prompts without answer leakage

perturbation_categories.name: confidence_gray_zone_abstention_variants
perturbation_categories.non_vacuous_gate: abstention precision and coverage use independent denominators

perturbation_categories.name: localized_formal_feedback_repair_variants
perturbation_categories.non_vacuous_gate: feedback localizes a failing constraint and final repair passes semantic checks

prior_failure_modes.principle: new experiments must address known negative verifier-gain results
acceptance and rejection must be measured separately
abstain is not success unless it catches risky rows
identical metric values need independent row-level denominators
formal feedback must show lift beyond fallback enumeration
live-inference claims need credible duration and substrate provenance
matrix/capstone blockers stay blocked until rerun gates clear

exp3080.next_milestone_recommendation: 2026.05.288: reduce publication_blocker_count from 42 by first clearing verifier-gain recovery (fix or retire Exp3070 adversarial flags, raise abstention_precision to the gate, rerun Exp3072), then run Exp3075 repair micro-panel only after that gate passes; in parallel commit the GateMate output contract and host-visible smoke transcript so SSQA can leave gate-skipped status; keep FR-11 controller-only until the completeness budget is zero and keep EBT/ARM-EBM projection-only until an adapter implementation has tests.

repair_disqualifiers.condition: repair is derived from a known answer, expected output, or solver assignment
repair_disqualifiers.reason: Repair must generalize from localized failure, not copy labels.

repair_disqualifiers.condition: only syntax, parser, JSON, or schema status improves
repair_disqualifiers.reason: Semantic validation is the repair authority.

repair_disqualifiers.condition: deterministic fallback output is counted as LLM repair success
repair_disqualifiers.reason: Fallback and generated repair substrates must stay separate.

repair_disqualifiers.condition: repair uses non-headline tiny model output as headline SOTA evidence
repair_disqualifiers.reason: Model identity substitutions need explicit bounded labels.

repair_disqualifiers.condition: repaired candidate passes verifier by changing the task intent
repair_disqualifiers.reason: Repair must preserve fixture intent and behavioral tests.

research_reference_comparisons.finding: Verification can be harder than solving and can be insensitive to perturbations.
research_reference_comparisons.local_consequence: Exp 3084-3085 must include label-preserving and label-flipping perturbations.

research_reference_comparisons.finding: Confidence-aware abstention moves coverage and reliability together.
research_reference_comparisons.local_consequence: Exp 3086 must report coverage, precision, and reliability by decision bucket.

research_reference_comparisons.finding: Code-task abstention can use execution consistency rather than oracle leakage.
research_reference_comparisons.local_consequence: Exp 3087 must separate execution-consistency abstention from correctness labels.

research_reference_comparisons.finding: Improving generation does not automatically improve self-verification.
research_reference_comparisons.local_consequence: FR-11 rows must measure verifier improvement separately from solver improvement.

research_reference_comparisons.finding: Formal feedback needs structural anchors and vacuity guards.
research_reference_comparisons.local_consequence: Exp 3088 must prove guided lift over solver-only and reject syntax-only success.
